reviews.text:
Great respect and care for elderly dying dog. I've been caring for it since the death of the owner had to make a decision harder than making one for my own dog.  I felt comfortable here. And definitely NOT overcharged by people who want money. These folks CARE. Felt comfortable taking a good friend with her first dog here shortly after. He was a young pup around women so much he barked a men, he still liked his Aussie vet. Belly rubs got good points. Sammy left comfortably.

Oct. 2025 sadly today they helped me when my (second) service dog passed away.  He's much more than a pet and they understood this.
Poor communication

TLDR: We always feel welcomed at VCC Pet Care. Front desk representatives are kind, warm and welcoming,the doctors actually listen, and Dr. Nishiyama and Dr.Sharp plus all their empanelled doctor teams and the other receptionists are why I keep coming back.

I bring my dog here because walking in already feels different. Nobody treats you like a ticket number. The front desk and receptionists are great. They greet you, they know how to settle a worried pet parent, and they keep things moving without making you feel rushed. Jazz and the other receptionists I have spoken with are a big part of that. You can tell they care about the animal in the lobby, not just the clipboard. They also have complimentary water and dog treats!! 🐾

The doctors are the other half. VCC has a panel of people who genuinely care about whoever you bring in, dog or otherwise. They are responsive. They are understanding. They are collaborative. If I have a concern, they do not wave it off. They talk it through. They explain options. They help me decide what is actually best, not what is easiest to sell.

That shows up most on the practical stuff: vaccinations, treatments, what to do next. They advise what my dog needs and why. I leave knowing the plan, not guessing. That is rare, and I do not take it lightly.

I especially appreciate Dr. Nishiyama and Dr. Sharp . Thoughtful, clear, and kind with both the pet and the person holding the leash. Combined with Jazz and the rest of the front desk personnels (sorry guys I'm bad with names if you reading this 🥹 nonetheless I appreciate y'all!🫶), this is a clinic that treats you like a partner in your pet’s care.

I am grateful for this team. I will keep coming.

Love and regards,
Blake’s Mom
Rhea Sharma 😊
The most reasonal Vet in all of Hollywood.
Helped me out in a pinch quickly and efficiently. Appreciate their willingness to help without a second thought.

We have used this vet since moving to the LA area and we love it here. They've helped us when we were panicking about bloody stool for one dog, and general checkup and care for the other. They even had some great advice and helped us with training tips and with a prescription for our high-anxiety dog. They are always professional and friendly when we see them.

Edit: 5 years since the original post. Just following up to say we are still with them. Going on probably 7 years now. Still extremely happy and satisfied with the care they provide to our dogs.
Great veterinarian for your dog. I've taken my dog there for 6 years!

Rachel Brownell is amazing. She is always honest about what she believes may be going on with your pet and understands that finances can sometimes be a concern. She truly does her best to provide the highest quality care while working within your budget whenever possible.
She is thoughtful, understanding, compassionate, and genuinely cares about both her patients and their owners. Because of the trust and confidence I have in her, I made sure she became the primary veterinarian for all of my pets. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a veterinarian who is knowledgeable, caring, and transparent.

DON’T BRING YOUR PET TO THIS PLACE! My dog has an immediately side effect from a vaccine medication and instead they let me know they make me spend more money and don’t gave me the correct information! The test is taking to long and the cleaning conditions in the rooms are terrible , the place looks good in the “looking” but they don’t sanitize the tables before they do the exams inside the rooms, and I also hair from the another dogs in this tables! This is very alarming, you don’t know if the dog that consulted in this rooms before your dog have a contagious disease ! I came back there and I leave because they want to bring me the dog inside and want charge a different rate for consultation since is emergency, but the emergency was because of the effect of a the the medication that they gave to him! I wish to put zero starts but this option are not allowed!

Please DONT take your pet to this place! My baby cat died in a low risk surgery and they didn’t give me explanations. Putting the fault on my cat when was a surgery to get her spayed. They did the blood exams and told me my cat was fine to get the surgery then after they told me my baby cat die because probably had a hearth disease which the blood exam didn’t show.
My hearth is broken, I regret every second of my life had taken my cat to this place!
Please don’t take your loved animals here!

Very impressed with the staff and their understanding of my high anxiety Malinois. We came in for a chipped tooth. The vet we saw had previous experience with working dogs and it made me feel much more comfortable.  Will definitely be coming back here and also recommending to anyone in the area. You can see their entire waiting area from the parking lot which is wonderful because my dog is not great around other dogs and I was able to see how many dogs were in there before bringing her in. When I spoke with them about this they were very nice. Everything about my experience was wonderful and I am super impressed with Audrey and Dr. Kohan. Audrey is the best tech I've ever had. Thank you thank you thank you 💞 cant wait to bring in my other dog so they can both have Dr. Kohan as their regular vet.
Very nice staff, clean facility and knowledgeable vets that take the time to explain the condition my Frenchie has.
Amazing staff! They take such great care of my buddy Frank!!

I took my new puppy here to establish care and to get UTI symptoms checked out. The first Dr I saw took a urine sample and results came back that my puppy had crystals in her urine to which the Dr prescribed a special diet.

My puppy's UTI symptoms immediately resolved upon starting this new diet,though I needed to get her seen for allergy, skin, gastrointestinal, and ear issues which I suspected was due to food allergies or environmental allergies.

The second Dr that saw her was incompetent, told me she should not be on the prescription diet for her urinary issues (even though the diet was helping), said she was too young to have urinary issues and that puppies just pee a lot, said he had a lot more experience than the first Dr I saw and to dimiss the first Dr's diagnosis, and blamed all of her obvious symptoms of allergies on an ear infection.

I immediately took her to a different veterinarian clinic to which they promptly and accurately diagnosed her very obvious allergies and also suggested a recheck of her urine to make sure it was OK to switch her prescription diet.

I don't recommend Veterinary Care Center and will not be coming back here.

I have been looking for a new vet who has an incredible and friendly staff, clean facilities, honesty about pricing, payment plan options, and most of all ones that were truly knowledgable. My dog is very sensitive and they took everything very slow with her to make her comfortable, the doctor explained my options without making me feel like a bad person for not being able to shell out tons of cash in a day, and they solved a problem my dog has had for nine years because they actually knew their stuff. I am so thankful to have found them.

I absolutely love this place. I had Dr. Sherman who saved my Bernese Mountain Dog, Lola. After bringing my dog to another vet, I tried Dr. Sherman whom was not only lovely, but discovered my dog had Stage 2 kidney disease! She instantly helped me put a diet plan into play along with the proper medication. I liked her so much that I even brought my  other dog, Charlie. She told me to come back in two months to see how the medication is helping Lola. I have just called to arrange her follow up appointment and I’m now feeling lost because I was just told her Vet is no longer there! I only just switched both my dogs 2 months ago and no one there bothered telling me? Where am I supposed to go now? Can anyone tell me where Dr. Ella Sherman is?

Can't stop raving about this place!
Maybe more so because the day prior, had the WORST SCAM experience at Urgent Paw Care in Duarte.

So where do we start... Our family dog got viciously attacked by a pitbull while taking his daily walk on a leash.  We took him to our vet right away, but really couldn't see any marks due to his dense hair, but was advised by the vet, if we see anything, come right back.  The following week while giving him a bath, that's when we noticed a puncture in his skin the size of a quarter! We took him right back to the vet and he advised we go somewhere where they would accommodate surgery if needed.

After calling MULTI places, I finally found Urgent Paws (and although it was 15miles out) we decided with all the great reviews, we would take him here.

On the phone, the assistance was great, and even when we walked in (we were the ONLY ones there) the VA's where great.  Gentle with the dog, caring, petting him for assurance.  Then we waited for almost 15mins + for Dr. Brown to come in.  Right off the bat, her vibe was not assuring.  My dog did not feel comfortable with her AT ALL.   From the door, she had the VA give us a muzzle to put on my dog (which I understand for some dogs may get vicious).  She then comes, checks his pulse, just LOOKS at the wound (doesn't even TOUCH IT) and walks out.  15+mins later, the VA comes in with the estimate of procedure.

The exam fee was $141
They stated we needed surgery (once again without even really LOOKING at his wounds) and the cost would be $2500+ - $3500+ depending.  AND that doesn't guarantee that they would be even ABLE to finish the procedure.  If during the procedure they feel they cannot finish, then we would need to get transferred to ANOTHER facility.
They told me I can get some time to think about it, BUT if I decide to come back the next day, since it would be ANOTHER doctor that would be looking at our dog, they would charge us ANOTHER $75 and the assessment from THAT doctor might be different.  WHAT!
It seemed like they were just out there for the money..

So, I decided to call my friends with pets and contacted The Veterinary Care Center in Hollywood.  They were REALLY friendly, and I got a spot for the next day @ 10:30am.  When we arrived, staff was great.  Didn't have to wait long for Dr. Klem to come in.  He was SO friendly, even got comfortable with my dog, and was looking around his whole body not just for that one injury, but incase he had others from the attack.

They gave me different options, but I was told that he did NOT need surgery, and if they cleaned the wound, it would eventually heal itself within a month.  BUT If we really did want surgery, it would cost $1500 - $1900 (due to his age and weight).  OMG!  The best place ever!  AND their assessment charge was only $85 VS Urgent Paws $141..

Urgent Paw's Fee $141 (nothing done)
The Veterinary Care Center Fee $455.65 (everything included with a happy dog)

Thank you so much!

I also called them 3 days after our visit to get our records to make a police report and they were SO friendly, quick, and even asked how our dog was doing!
This is a terrible vet, do yourself a favor and switch to modern animal.

TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE, I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS VETERINARIAN TO ANYONE!

POOR QUALITY SERVICE FROM A TEAM OF RUDE UNPROFESSIONAL STAFF.

- not acknowledged upon approaching the desk despite none of the staff being on the phone.

-over an hour long vet visit even with an appointment

-staff did not obtain my pets medical records from their primary vet which prolonged the visit despite being given veterinarians office info

- Veterinarian got an attitude and became dismissive when I mentioned the duration of visit being longer than expected

-Veterinarian did not share any feedback on test results or diagnosis at the end of visit. The vet technician simply walked out with my dog and medication.

- filed a complaint with Hospital manager Elizabeth about unpleasant experience . Hospital manager left for the weekend before providing any resolution or feedback. It has been a week and still no response or follow up from anyone.

This place is a joke of an establishment and a sorry excuse for a veterinarians office.

I highly recommend going to the Melrose Vet (just a short 10 minute drive away) over this poorly run facility.

They were very attentive and gentle with our pets. Out cat has a lot of medical problems but they provide phenomenal care and treat him not just the numbers. Also provide reasonable prices without judgement.

I've had my dog for 13 years, and of the 10 years I've lived in LA, I've usually come to VCC.

Overall, I've had a great experience with them. Dr. Christian Amezcua did a tumor removal for my sweet girl Ellie when she had a mast cell tumor, and did a wonderful job. It gave her another 3 years of life. And after each treatment/surgery, they provided statements quickly so I could get reimbursed through insurance.

My dog Ellie became extremely ill this past week, and I brought her to VCC. The staff was warm and friendly, and urged me to go to MASH for an emergency doctor since there weren't any doctors available that day. After MASH provided a critical diagnosis, I brought her to VCC the next day to help her transition on. Dr. Rachel Brownell was my doctor that day and she listened thoroughly, help me reach a very hard conclusion, and held very sacred space as I held Ellie in her final moments.

Not every appointment was a perfect one over the last 10 years, but I do think all the doctors and staff here try their best to give you as many resources and options as possible for your fur baby. Thanks VCC!

I came to this clinic during one of the most difficult moments a pet owner can face to discuss euthanasia for my 13-year-old dog, who is suffering and can barely walk.

For transparency, dogs are weighed and evaluated first, and if they are over a certain weight, the cost increases. Euthanasia is not guaranteed and is at the veterinarian’s discretion, which I understand.

What made this experience extremely upsetting was the lack of compassion and professionalism shown. Despite clearly explaining my dog’s condition, I was repeatedly pressured to try medications after I had already said no. Dr. Sherman stated that my request for euthanasia was “out of convenience” and described it as controversial, which was incredibly hurtful given my dog’s age and declining quality of life.

Dr. Sherman mentioned that there was a list of other clinics that provide euthanasia services. However, when I asked the front desk for this list, they refused to provide it. Instead, staff discussed my situation openly at the front desk, within earshot. I heard staff members talking about my request and making judgmental comments implying that I had decided to put my dog down without trying anything.

One front desk staff member even suggested, in a dismissive tone, that I could surrender my dog to a shelter if I wanted him euthanized. Being spoken to this way while dealing with an elderly, suffering pet was completely inappropriate and deeply upsetting.

While Dr. Sherman ultimately declined to perform the euthanasia which I respect the way the situation was handled lacked empathy, privacy, and basic respect. No pet owner should be made to feel judged or shamed during such a painful decision.

The exam fee was $85. If you are seeking compassionate end-of-life care, I recommend looking elsewhere. I personally had a much better experience with Honor Pet.

I hope this clinic takes this feedback seriously and improves staff professionalism and empathy, especially during end-of-life situations.
very good people working here, understanding and empathetic. reasonable pricing too. i recommend coming here if you have a cat or dog, tho im not sure if they care for other animals
Great place for animal care, friendly and caring staff and doctors.

They took very good care of my cats. Not all vets look at cats properly, but they do! They also got me in quickly without an appointment. Vet took their time explaining to me what was going on, and even called a few days later to check in. Clinic is affordable and they have a huge parking lot & waiting room.
The vets here are excellent and provide comprehensive care.

Had a stellar referral and it was fine. Then seemed to spiral as doctors didn’t read the extensive notes and medical records and ended up doing tests that had already been done and wanted an ultrasound sound where they somehow cut my cats nipples causing to to be bleeding all night. The front desk is rad and in it but some of the assistants to the docs aren’t very careful especially with anxious cats.

This place I thought was a great place but only for deworming and vacs. Sydney is disgustingly rude on the phone with no answers. She sounds annoyed to ever answer questions and my kitten is pooping blood they said came back with negative results for parisites. I can hear the front desk staff socializing in the background and she clearly wants to get back to that instead of addressing my call. Whatever. I guess I will go to somewhere else more professional because of Sydney and the lack of care about my pet!

I visited the Veterinary Care Center a couple of weeks ago for my 4 year old cat after he started peeing blood. It’s been a couple of weeks and while he is still having issues, I have felt so supported by every single vet, nurse, and staff member that I have interacted with. Dr Rachel Brownell is our vet and she has been very promptly answering all of my questions via email, which has been so helpful as we navigate his care. She was very sweet and thorough when we were in office for the exam as well. I would also say their prices are super reasonable, especially for the care we have been receiving. The front desk staff are quick to answer questions and walk me through new meds. Overall I am so happy and they have a customer for life, would recommend this place to anyone. Thank you!!

This veterinary center has been taking a wonderful care of my dog for 8 years already. I’m so grateful to their knowledgeable doctors and friendly personnel for doing an amazing job every time we’re visiting. My dog is still nervous about visiting a vet but not me anymore: they’re always very accommodating, attentive to details, spend all the time you need explaining and answering your questions. Such a relief to have a veterinary center you can trust the health of your companion without a second thought. Special thanks to doctor Amezcua, he’s always been great regarding health issues of my dog and helped us a lot.

Update: Sadly, my recent experience has been very different. After Dr. Amezcua removed a lump that turned out to be a malignant mast cell tumor with thin margins, his advice was simply to “monitor” it. The tumor came back within two months, and when I later took my dog to several oncologists, they were surprised we hadn’t been referred to them right away. They explained that with this type and grade of tumor as on the initial biopsy, immediate treatment was necessary and could have made a big difference in the outcome. It was heartbreaking to learn that this step wasn’t taken sooner.
They took the best care of my little baby turnip and were so understanding of how scared she was

This was the best vet experience I have ever had and I will forever recommend this clinic to anyone that has a pet. Though they are a busy clinic I always feel prioritized and as though I was given special care. Everyone is kind and efficient. I never felt like I was being oversold and my pet was getting the best care possible. I would give 10 stars if I could. Thanks to the team my cat is home healing from a major surgery and I am forever grateful.
Luna seems happy and comfortable visiting, and that's saying a lot. She's usually quite skiddish. So, our daughter is very happy to have came in on the recommendation of a coworker.
I brought my dog in alive, they said they needed two hours to run tests, and when i came back he was dead.

Wow!! For the first time in my life I didn’t come out of the vet feeling like I got taken advantage of. My 45 lb dog had diarrhea for the past 2 days and once we saw that it wasn’t getting any better we decided to make the dreaded trip to the vet. I called multiple clinics to see if they had same day appointments but they didn’t have anything available. Finally I called The Veterinary Care Center and the  receptionist was so friendly and offered a few appointment times. I had to pay a $100 deposit to hold my spot and took him in. I was in and out within 1 hour and my bill was so reasonable!!! This is for sure our new vet! I am just sad that I didn’t find them any sooner. Thank you to the team for being so helpful, quick, and easy!

Very convenient hours and wonderful doctors. Process are normal for the area. Ihave been bringing my pets here for years and have only had good experiences. My pets have always been treated with care and attention to detail.
Nice place with nice people.

We brought our cats here when we moved to Hollywood over a year ago and it seemed fine. The doctor was great and the staff was very friendly.  Our last couple of visits have been a mess. Every time we come in we see a different vet. Not seem to be very competent. The staff is extremely disorganized.  They charged us for a bunch of medications and then gave us one we didn't even buy.  Omg.  Took forever to actually get the meds and get refund for what we didn't get.  This is the last time I'm visiting this place. Terrible.

I called in and emailed in a signed prescription for a medication, but I was told they will not fill it unless I get an exam with them. I offered to send my pet's medical history to prove she's been examined by a vet less than 48 hours ago and provide context for why a doctor signed the prescription (you'd think the signed prescription itself would be enough). Didn't matter, they will extort you for an exam fee just to fill a prescription.

We were very happy at VCC, especially with Dr. Goldman. We are going to make our appointments with Dr. Goldman all the time.
We were there today 7/20/2025 and I just want to say that every time we go to VCC, we are treated in the best way. Thank you Dr. Goldman and VCC. We love that we are covered with great care 7 days a week. Dr. Goldman and Dr. Bouganim are the best. The staff is wonderful
Dr. Goldman really remembers all the details about your pet.  So thankful.

I ususally go to Melrose Vet but i decided to try this place..

What a dump.  I should have known better when i walked into the parking lot over weeds, garbage and human poop

front desk staff is super rude. I walked out.

Terrible experience. The staff was disorganized, the vet seemed rushed and uninterested, and I was pushed into expensive tests with no clear explanation. On top of that, I was overcharged for something I didn’t agree to. Won’t be coming back.
Never again!

I brought my 8-year-old micro Maltese to VCC because she was hacking and clearly unwell. Without running any blood work, CT, MRI, or further testing, the doctor took one look at the X-ray and immediately diagnosed her with cancer—then told me I would need to put her down. The doctor was not only abrupt and insensitive but also dismissive and cold during what was already an emotional time.

Thankfully, I did not follow their advice. I took my dog to another animal hospital for a second opinion, where they properly evaluated her and diagnosed pneumonia, not cancer. She was treated with antibiotics and steroids and is already much more stable than she was after being at VCC for 24 hours.

This experience was incredibly traumatic and could have ended in tragedy had I not sought another opinion. Please, for the safety of your pet, always get a second opinion. I strongly advise against bringing your pet here if you want compassionate, thorough, and accurate care.
Quick and responsive team - Jose the managing director was super helpful, via email, in determining best needs for our pets. Love an honest business - thank you!

Plenty of parking and available late appointments, friendly staff and fast service.
Couple of years ago I wanted to switch from my previous vet and they didn't accept new patients, I am glad I checked back and at the date of this review they took in both of my dogs with very convenient and immediately available appointments.
I'm so glad I checked back.

Domenique V.
7110 La Brea
Hollywood, Los Angeles, California 90046

To Whom It May Concern,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to address a misunderstanding regarding the kitten I brought into your facility around the 2nd of May. It has come to my attention that the kitten, whom I was treating and intended to adopt, has been given to another individual. I would like to clarify my position and express my concerns about this situation.

As you are aware, I brought the kitten to your clinic for medical care and support. At no point did I intend to relinquish my rights to this animal. I had made arrangements to pick up the kitten 10 days after the 2nd of May, which would have been approximately the 12th of May, as discussed with your staff. Unfortunately, the decision to transfer custody of the kitten to a third party without my consent has left me feeling both confused and distressed.

The individual who is currently caring for the kitten was not the primary caregiver but merely offered financial assistance during a time when I could not. While I appreciate her willingness to help, it was clear that I intended to reclaim my kitten once it was healthy, as agreed upon during our consultations.

I would kindly request that you review your policies regarding animal custody and ensure that such situations are handled with clearer communication and respect for the rights of the individual who initially brought in the pet for care. It is important to me that the well-being of the kitten is prioritized, and I firmly believe that I am still that kitten's rightful owner.

I am eager to resolve this matter amicably and would appreciate your guidance on how to proceed. Thank you for your attention to this matter, and I hope to hear from you soon.

Sincerely,

Domenique V.
7110 La Brea
Hollywood, Los Angeles, California 90046

Earl Abraham II RVT (Registered vet tech and apparently COO) launched a verbal attack today on my voicemail. Luckily it is recorded and I turned it over to the VMB of California enforcement office they were very interested to hear a tech denied me service at a clinic. He is not even a dvm (earl could probably not pass the exam to get into school and feel inferior and like to throw his “authority “ around. VMB said they are going to audit VCC based upon my complaint.
Non fancy, good docs.
I love the Veterinary Care Center! They have taken care of our animals and are so attentive. I’ve been coming here since 2017, and it’s always been a positive experience. Thank you!

I am so happy with the care my cat has received here! He recently got some dental extractions and the whole process was surprisingly stress-free. Everyone that I have interacted with is very patient, friendly, and knowledgeable. Also their hours of operation make it very easy to make an appointment that works with your availability! Couldn’t say enough great things about Veterinary Care Center.

Receptionist very rude. Also they charged 2 times for the same treatment 2 weeks apart because. The doctor was not in so they sent me to another doctor without calling. Then they charged me two separate office visits and two separate eye exams. Double charged. They refuse to acknowledge you that they did this. They over charge in a different manner. Ruder than rude.
Easy to get an appointment. Friendly staff. But the best part is flexibility to get an appointment.

i brought my dog in for exams. zero explanation of what exams need to be done. give you one price and charge another. then say it was miscommunication. i specifically have mentioned he will rip his leash.  they left it on him and he ripped it. now i have to buy a new leash.  i will never come back to this scam of an establishment.

This review is pacifically for Dr. Paxton, I’ve never had an issue with any of the other staff here.
Do not let your animal get seen by Dr. Paxton!! This guy Has no idea what he’s doing and I’m shocked that he’s even still working here.  A few years ago, I rescued a stray cat that was hit by a car. We had our surgery at a low-cost surgery center, but I had to switch his cast every two weeks. This was supposed to go on for three months, but Dr. Paxton insisted that he was still healing and prolonged the Initial estimated time. The final time I saw Dr. Paxton, We got home from him re-wrapping my cats leg (600$) and my cat flung the cast Off of his leg while running away from me. To my surprise, what was underneath was disturbing, it was obviously infected at first glance. The next day I brought my cat back to the vet but this time to Dr. Johnson, and I was informed that his leg was severely infected to the point where they had to actually BOARD him to monitor him, which cost me another $900.
Obviously, I was never offered a Refund for the $600 I paid for Dr. Paxton to put another cast over my cats infected leg, So Do not make the same mistake as I did trusting this creep because it could be an expensive one.

This Vet Center has stepped up their game.

They were very sweet and on point last time I came in to take care of my cat Panda.

Very gentle and loving. I had a great day with Panda the other day getting her vaccines and annual exam.
Everyone was great and our dog came out better and wagging his tail. The parking lot is nice too.
Can be a little pushy playingon your sentiments when it comes to protecting your fur baby in certain  things but they provide some of the best veterinary care in LA.
Had a fantastic experience here with the care of my boy Bleu. C/Katherine the tech was so kind and informative, such a doll! Everyone was very gentle with Bleu. Thank you VCC
Was great. Saw us quickly and resolved the issue. My cat hates the vet and has a history of going wild and needing to be sedated. She had a calm experience here.

The worst!  No one not to have told me that the opthamologist leaves as soon as he is done looking at the dog.  Otherwise, I would have gladly stayed hours just to have been given the chance to speak with the doctor; give history, and to have found out anything about what is wrong with my dogs eye.  I know nothing about the problem, I dont even know what the medicine is that I was given.  A real  disappointment in care, and shocked by not being able to speak with the doctor, my dog's eye was bleeding, some tech just handed me medicine and they charged over $400.  OMG -* * the rest is in response to the Vet Care center posted a response - ** even though the vet care center said the doctor called - the office did not give him my message that I could stay and speak to them, but the office assured me he would still be there when I came back in an hour and a half.  I just got off the phone with the doctor and he also was very disappointed the front office didn't tell him my message.  I had been very clear that I would be able to stay if time was a problem.  I was NEVER told the doctor leaves after the check up, He only left a message with 'call me" and when I did call back they weren't sure if he had left, and then if the nurse was there.  Nothing.  Ultimately the doctor did call - after I posted the first half of this review, when they wrote their response.  Good news the optomologist is issuing a refund and I have another appointment at a different doctor.
Just called to see how much it would cost to see how many kittens my Maine coone is gonna have, he tried to rip me off then got offended when I said no thanks and hung up on me, customer service 0/10
Love this center. They take very good care of our cat!
Couldn’t thank them enough, great people who really do care for animals.
The receptionist seemed pretty polite over the phone. But unfortunately they only help existing clients with their pets. Save yourself some time and call some place else if time is of the essence.
Always very helpful and kind. Love this vet!

I haven’t been in a few months but I talk about this place to everyone. I no longer live in Los Angeles and since moving it’s been challenging to find a veterinarian center like this one! If you’re in LA, this place is so amazing! They never try to over charge you, and are always truly in service for you and your fur one! Thank you a thousand times <3 Also, very efficient service if you are planning to leave the country with your little one. I had a nightmare experience with the vets in SD and VCC really turned that experience around. You guys are the best! Wiley says thank you 🐾
Thank you for your professionalism, help & kindness. Lilo is doing great! <3

Don’t even waste your time calling if you want to bring your dog here. Just called to make an appointment for my dog and they aren’t taking new clients. I guess they don’t need to make more money. They should just add it on their website so we don’t waste our time.
